adjudication.retracted: The earlier M4 notes that attributed 850/1000 to a transponder/day-column mix-up and reported the three-PVP no-transponder vector as 1000/1430 are withdrawn. They resulted from flattening a summary table's class/payment columns. The standalone PVP1046 base tariff is 380/450, not 450/770.
adjudication.confirmed: Direct current operator pages for PVP1093, PVP1184 and PVP1223 give 150/150, 300/350 and 400/500 RUB respectively for Category I on Mon–Thu / Fri–Sun. Their full three-PVP vector therefore corresponds to the user's 850/1000 RUB vector; date-selected Yandex checks from the PVP1093 vicinity to Krasnodar display the same approximate totals for a car under 2 m without a transponder.
adjudication.remaining: PVP1046 base cells and the four-PVP southbound vector are now normalized and match the route-specific Yandex controls. Complete M4 vector coverage, direct local preservation of the detailed tariff appendix for PVP1046, and other M4 payment-road groups remain. Yandex route estimates are approximate route-specific controls; exact map route cards do not list each toll point.
